subject: Access control evidence package request (SAML/SCIM/RBAC) for MediHealth SOC2
messages:
From: Alice Zhao <alice.zhao@medihealth.com>
To: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.com>
Cc: security@medihealth.com
Date: Tue, 7 Dec 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Request: SSO/SCIM/RBAC evidence for upcoming SOC2 audit

Alex —

We’re kicking off our SOC2 readiness review for our platform integrations and Redwood is in scope. Our audit team asked for a compact package of access-control evidence that covers: SAML assertion samples (including NameID and common attributes), SCIM provisioning/delta snapshots for the last 30 days, a current RBAC role matrix (permissions mapped to roles), and a short narrative explaining least-privilege defaults and any delegated admin flows.

Can you confirm whether you can provide these artifacts and an ETA? Ideally we’d get an initial bundle by next week (deadline: 2026-12-14) for reviewer intake, with any heavier logs arriving shortly after. If there are any constraints (PII redaction, redaction windows, or transfer method restrictions) please call them out.

Thanks — I can hop on a quick call if useful.

Alice Zhao
Senior Security Engineer, MediHealth
alice.zhao@medihealth.com
security@medihealth.com

Attachment: list-of-required-evidence.txt (stub)

From: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.com>

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 7 Dec 2026 09:38:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Request: SSO/SCIM/RBAC evidence for upcoming SOC2 audit

Alice —

Thanks for the clear list. We can assemble the requested package. Quick summary of what we can deliver and proposed timeline:

- SAML assertion samples: yes (redacted where necessary). We’ll provide examples that include typical NameID formats and the standard attribute set we map (email, groups, tenant_id).
- SCIM provisioning/delta snapshots: we can provide a 30-day delta export; some entries will require pseudonymization depending on customer data rules.
- RBAC role matrix: export of current role definitions and permission sets (CSV).
- Least-privilege narrative: short PDF describing our default roles, admin boundaries, and justifications for elevated permissions.

Proposed delivery: initial starter bundle (SAML samples + RBAC CSV + narrative) by 2026-12-09; full SCIM delta archive by 2026-12-14. If you need everything earlier let us know and we’ll prioritize.

Marissa — can you confirm the SCIM extraction approach and whether we need any additional approvals for the delta archive? Ben — looping you in on ETA/procurement expectations.

Best,
Alex Martinez
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
alex.martinez@redwood.com

Subject: Re: Request: SSO/SCIM/RBAC evidence for upcoming SOC2 audit

Thanks Alex / Alice —

Technical details and notes for the package:

1) SAML assertion samples
- We’ll provide 5 anonymized assertion examples that reflect the three most common NameID formats we emit (email, persistent, transient) and include attribute examples for: email, displayName, groups, tenant_id.
- Files: saml-assertion-samples.txt (includes header lines and redaction markers).
- Notes: any attributes with PII will be replaced with stable pseudonyms; we’ll include a mapping guide in the bundle.

2) SCIM provisioning/delta snapshots
- Export: scim-delta-snapshot-20261207.zip — compressed CSVs covering create/update/delete events for the last 30 days across provisioning endpoints.
- Redaction: user identifiers will be hashed; we’ll include a count of unique users and an event distribution summary.
- Compliance: delivery will be via our secure Share folder (Drive link below) or an SFTP bundle depending on your ingestion policy.

3) RBAC role matrix
- Export: rbac-role-matrix.csv — role -> permission -> description. We’ll include notes on default assignments for new tenants and recommended least-privilege adjustments.

4) Least-privilege narrative
- PDF: least-privilege-justification.pdf — 2 pages explaining default role decisions, any forced elevation flows (timeboxed admin sessions), and our approval/recording process.

Constraints / ask from your side
- If you need raw email addresses in the SCIM export for mapping, confirm an approved DPA transfer. Without that we must pseudonymize.
- Confirm preferred delivery mechanism (Drive link vs SFTP) and whether you need MD5 checksums or signed manifests.

Delivery plan
- Starter bundle (SAML samples + RBAC CSV + narrative): 2026-12-09 EOD PT.
- Full SCIM delta archive: 2026-12-14 EOD PT (or earlier if you permit Drive access).

I’ve uploaded stubs to the shared folder for review: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aB_cd_EXAMPLE

Regards,
Marissa Cole
Senior Security Programs, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
